products.name: Pebble
products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: Light shaped for comfort, people and environment.
products.summary: Pebble is a brand-new addition to the Holophane range — a post-top area luminaire built from the ground up around visual comfort, and a Build Back Better Gold Award winner. At its centre is a recessed Comfort Optic paired with Holophane's PrismaLED diffusion technology, blending the six-module LED array into a single soft, evenly lit surface instead of six individual points of glare. The optic is fully rotatable and available across five distributions, from a tight Symmetric spread to Forward Throw Extra, and the recessed design keeps ULOR at a flat 0% for genuine dark-sky compliance. Pebble ships in three mounting configurations — Post-top, Side-entry and Cradle-mount — so one luminaire family covers pathways, plazas, car parks and campus routes without changing specification. A single-fixing replaceable optical pod and a thermally engineered aluminium housing keep it serviceable in the field, and it's ready to integrate with wireless lighting controls for daylight, presence and time-based operation. Covering 3,100–20,000 delivered lumens, it's patent-pending — genuinely new technology, not a reskin of an existing range.

backlightControl.heading: Light shaped for visual comfort
backlightControl.body: Behind Pebble's soft, even glow is a carefully engineered optical system. Six individual LED modules sit behind Holophane's PrismaLED diffusion lenses, blending what would normally be six distinct points of glare into a single luminous surface — all while the recessed optical architecture keeps the light source positioned deeper within the housing, out of the direct line of sight at typical pedestrian viewing angles. The result is a fitting that looks as comfortable to be near as the light it produces.
points: PrismaLED diffusion blends the six-module LED array into one soft, evenly lit surface instead of six individual points of glare
Recessed optical architecture positions the light source deeper within the luminaire, reducing glare and improving visual comfort at pedestrian viewing angles
A single-fixing, interchangeable optical POD carries the Comfort Optic across all five distributions, simplifying servicing and future reconfiguration in the field

backlightControl.heading: Low glare by design
backlightControl.body: Holophane's Optimax™ reflector technology spreads the light from each LED over its own modular, faceted reflector rather than letting it radiate from a single bright point. As lumen packages scale from one module up to six, the same reflector geometry builds up across the array, so the luminaire gains output without multiplying point-source glare. The deep-shielded source and low reflector wall brightness keep Prismpack visually comfortable to look at directly below, even at the highest lumen packages.
points: Each LED is spread across its own Optimax reflector, reducing apparent brightness compared with a regular LED high bay at the same output
Narrow (0.5:1 SHR), Medium (1:1 SHR) and Wide (1.6:1 SHR) reflector geometries tailor the beam to the building's geometry without sacrificing visual comfort
Available with a clear glass or prismatic glass (PrismaLED) lens, protecting the reflectors and LEDs from the industrial environment within

backlightControl.heading: Engineered to stay cooler, cleaner, longer
backlightControl.body: Holobay's low-electrostatic-charge glass optic resists dust and dirt accumulation, while curved ventilation fins create a venturi-effect self-cleaning airstream that draws cool, dense air across the optical lens and critical components. Conduction, convection and radiation are all engineered into the finned housing and thermally decoupled driver compartment, keeping LEDs within their thermal limit — and the patented hinged lid means the gear compartment stays just as easy to reach as it was to keep cool.
points: Glass optic's low electrostatic charge minimises dust and dirt buildup — a simple wipe restores 'as new' efficiency
Curved housing fins channel a venturi-effect self-cleaning airstream across the lens and gear compartment
LEDs sit at equal distance from the cooling vents and adjacent boards, keeping thermal variation — and lumen depreciation — even across the array

products.summary: Prismaspace fuses mid-power LEDs with Holophane's distinguished prismatic optics to deliver unparalleled uniformity for commercial and industrial interiors. Available as a single or double optical module, in IP40 or a sealed IP65 version, the IP65 optics rotate up to 180° (single) or 45° (double) in 15° increments — letting the distribution be customised on site to focus on the working plane, horizontal or vertical. backlightControl.heading: Application Flexibility
backlightControl.body: Prismaspace is ordered as a combination of options, so it's worth knowing what each one actually changes. The two that affect the physical luminaire are efficacy tier (Standard or HE) and sealing (IP40 or IP65) — the rest are driver and control choices that apply the same way across most Holophane ranges.
points: Standard vs HE (High Efficacy): Standard delivers each listed lumen package at the base efficacy; the .HE option bins the same mid-power LEDs for higher lm/W (up to 179 lm/W) at the same lumen output, cutting power draw and payback time without changing brightness

IP40 vs IP65: IP40 is the standard sealing for typical indoor environments; the IP65 version adds a fully sealed housing and unlocks the rotatable optical arm, letting the distribution be adjusted up to 180° (single module) or 45° (double module) in 15° increments on site
Emergency options (.EM1 / .EM3): a self-contained maintained emergency battery and inverter, in 1-hour or 3-hour duration, delivering c.500 lumens of emergency output

Control gear tiers (.CL7 / .CL8 / .CL9): pre-set constant light output profiles that hold the driver at 70%, 80% or 90% of initial lumens over the luminaire's life, compensating for natural LED lumen depreciation

HI-BEAM is Holophane's next-generation high bay, with an optic specifically developed for aisle and racking applications where precise control of light is needed to hit ground-level lux targets while maximising luminaire spacing and uniformity. A patented Transition Zone acts as an intermediary luminous band between the bright LEDs and the darker surrounding housing, softening the cascade of contrast and reducing perceived glare. products.name: High Mast Advanced Optix
products.manufacturerNote: Manufactured by Holophane (UK). Lumen Method is the exclusive Holophane specification agent for Australia.
products.tagline: High mast area lighting luminaire with prismatic borosilicate glass refractor optics, scaling from 30,000 to 100,000 delivered lumens across 6, 9 or 12 optical pod configurations, for freight terminals, ports, airports and motorways.
products.summary: High Mast Advanced Optix (HMAO) pairs the latest high-efficiency LED technology with Holophane's glass refractor optics to deliver a complete lighting solution for new-build and retrofit high mast applications, from the simplest to the most complex area lighting layouts. Each LED module sits behind its own prismatic borosilicate glass lens, forming an individual optical pod; HMAO is built from 6, 9 or 12 pods depending on the lumen package. The glass refractor's PrismGlow effect breaks up the image of the LEDs, reducing glare and hot spots for a more uniform vertical and horizontal lighting solution, while its low electrostatic charge and the ventilated, finned heat-sink chassis create a self-cleaning optic with lower lumen depreciation over time. Seven dedicated distributions and a rotatable optical assembly allow on-site alignment to specific lighting requirements.

backlightControl.heading: PrismGlow optics for uniform, low-glare high mast lighting
backlightControl.body: By combining the latest LED technology with Holophane's advanced glass refractor optic, HMAO breaks up the image of the LEDs with a PrismGlow effect. This reduces the glare normally associated with individual LEDs and eliminates hot spots on the working environment, creating a more uniform vertical and horizontal lighting solution. Glass's low electrostatic charge makes it less attractive to dust and dirt than aluminium or plastic optics, and works with the ventilated, finned heat-sink chassis to create a self-cleaning effect that enhances lumen maintenance over time.
points: Prismatic borosilicate glass refractor lenses, one per LED module, forming individually ventilated optical pods — 6, 9 or 12 per luminaire depending on lumen package
Self-cleaning optic: low-electrostatic glass plus a ventilated, finned heat-sink chassis reduce dirt depreciation and extend lumen maintenance
